justification: Both surfaces depict figures carved in low relief, and each includes an animal shown in profile plus some curvilinear ornament, but that is as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a legible architectural scene with columns, a staircase parapet, ordered files of standing human figures in procession and a lion attacking a bull, while B shows a single large rounded head-like mass with a fleshy, scroll-eyed, snouted creature and swirling volutes and no architecture, procession or human file at all.
